stories.title: Full list: Flintshire road closures and traffic lights for the week ahead
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has published its roadworks bulletin for the week of 4 to 11 September. It lists 17 full road closures and 25 sets of temporary traffic lights across the county. Some of the works run well beyond this week, into October, November and, in one case, March 2027. stories.title: Fudge Kitchen opens first new shop in almost a decade in Chester
stories.summary: Fudge Kitchen has opened a new shop at 6-8 Watergate Street in Chester. It is the company’s first new shop opening in almost ten years. stories.title: Othello cast announced ahead of Theatr Clwyd run this October
stories.summary: The cast has been announced for a new production of Othello, running at Theatr Clwyd from 20 to 24 October. The production moves Shakespeare’s story from Venice and Cyprus to Britain in the early 1980s, set against widespread rioting and the backdrop of the Falklands War. stories.title: Free Adult Learners’ Week event to be held at Flint Town Hall
stories.summary: A free walk-in event offering careers, learning and funding advice will be held at Flint Town Hall on Monday 21 September. The event, organised by Flintshire County Council’s Workforce Development Team, runs from 10am to 2pm as part of Adult Learners’ Week. stories.title: Police warning after elderly victims told to withdraw cash and post it to London
stories.summary: North Wales Police is warning people to be alert to scam phone calls, after two elderly victims were persuaded to withdraw large sums of cash and post it to addresses in London.
